evidence_items.locator: Executive Order 14365, section 1; mechanisms in sections 3, 5(b), and 8
evidence_items.explanation: The order directs legal challenges and preparation of federal preemption legislation, and asks agencies to assess conditioning grants on states not enacting or enforcing conflicting AI laws. Section 8 preserves specified categories in the proposed legislation, so the effort is substantial but not universal.

evidence_items.explanation: The release reports that the Senate removed a proposed ten-year state AI regulation moratorium. This limits any suggestion of unanimous federal opposition to state regulation, but does not negate the later executive effort.
The contemporaneous Senate record confirms the overwhelming amendment vote described in e2. Legislative resistance is compatible with an ongoing executive attempt to restrict state laws.
